message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) based on facts. The facts: defendant Li used a key obtained from bank (maybe via fraud) and knowledge of ATM password to open self-service cash machine (ATM) and stole cash 352,600 yuan. This is theft (robbery? No violence). It's unauthorized opening of ATM and stealing cash. The typical Chinese criminal law: "盗窃" (theft) for taking property. Also possibly "非法占有" is part of theft. The prosecution says "利用职务之便侵占他人财物" which suggests maybe "职务侵占" (embezzlement) but Li is not a bank employee? It says "利用职务之便" maybe he had some position? But facts: He used a key from bank (maybe he was bank employee?). The label likely "盗窃". In examples, similar case: multiple thefts of cash from ATMs were labeled "抢夺" if they used force, but here no force, just opening ATM. So "盗窃". Also maybe "非法占有" not a separate label. So answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>. No other crimes like "诈骗" etc. So final JSON.
